verdict.rationale: Global employment is a fair question for a payroll and HR product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no employer-of-record or international owned-entity payroll capability. The documented scope is US-centric: EINs, federal and state tax configuration, and multi-state work locations. One community report states Gusto doesn't support people outside the US.

support.subject: As a founder, I can employ people in other countries through employer-of-record or owned-entity global payroll
